text: For the expression `0 0 */7 * *`, the interval between consecutive firings is 7 days throughout 2024.
For the expression `0 0 15W * 5` with the constructor's default settings, the schedule fires on every Friday of 2024 in addition to the nearest weekday to the 15th of each month.
In the six-field (seconds-resolution) form, the expressions `0 0 0 * * 7` and `0 0 0 * * 0` expand to the same internal representation, because day-of-week 7 is aliased to 0.
The expression `0 0 31W * *` fires in every month of 2024, including February.
A croniter positioned exactly on a firing instant returns that same instant from get_prev().
croniter_range() includes both of its endpoints when those endpoints are themselves firing instants.
The expression `0 0 * * 1#5` fires in exactly 5 of the 12 months of 2024.
The expression `0 0 1-31/10 * *` fires on day 1, day 11, day 21 and day 31 of every month of 2024.
Passing implement_cron_bug=True changes which dates the expression `0 0 1 * 1` fires on in 2024.
The expressions `0 0 L * *` and `0 0 l * *` fire on exactly the same dates in 2024.
For `0 0 15W * 5`, passing day_or_union=True makes the schedule fire on strictly more dates in 2024 than the default settings do.
For the expression `0 0 31 * *`, the number of firings in 2024 equals the number of firings of `0 0 31W * *` in 2024.
Iterating `0 0 15W * *` backwards with get_prev() from 2025-01-01 yields exactly the reverse of the forward get_next() sequence over 2024.
For the expression `0 0 */7 * *`, the total number of firings in 2024 is 52.
